A '''researcher''' headed the team of scientists and researchers on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nathema]] that was working to discover a way to escape the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] after the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. The researcher presented the team's findings, namely a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Kamat Krote|route]] between [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] and [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]].
